title: Helpers--Installation, Maintenance, and Repair Workers
description: Help installation, maintenance, and repair workers in maintenance, parts replacement, and repair of vehicles, industrial machinery, and electrical and electronic equipment. Perform duties such as furnishing tools, materials, and supplies to other workers; cleaning work area, machines, and tools; and holding materials or tools for other workers.

tasks.text: Install or replace machinery, equipment, and new or replacement parts and instruments, using hand or power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Replacing machine parts requires hands and tools

dwas.name: Install machine or equipment replacement parts.

tasks.text: Examine and test machinery, equipment, components, and parts for defects to ensure proper functioning.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical equipment to locate damage, defects, or wear.
Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Tend and observe equipment and machinery to verify efficient and safe operation.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Detecting subtle equipment problems needs on-site sensory judgment

dwas.name: Observe equipment in operation to detect potential problems.

tasks.text: Adjust, connect, or disconnect wiring, piping, tubing, and other parts, using hand or power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting hoses to piping is manual fitting

dwas.name: Connect hoses to equipment or piping.
Connect electrical components or equipment.

tasks.text: Clean or lubricate vehicles, machinery, equipment, instruments, tools, work areas, and other objects, using hand tools, power tools, and cleaning equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lubrication task requiring hands and access

dwas.name: Clean work areas.
Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.

tasks.text: Hold or supply tools, parts, equipment, and supplies for other workers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Positioning hand tools requires manual dexterity

dwas.name: Assist skilled construction or extraction personnel.
Position hand tools.

tasks.text: Diagnose electrical problems and install and rewire electrical components.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Defect detection in electrical systems needs presence

dwas.name: Inspect electrical or electronic systems for defects.
Repair electrical components.

tasks.text: Disassemble broken or defective equipment to facilitate repair and reassemble equipment when repairs are complete.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disassembly requires hands-on tool use

dwas.name: Reassemble equipment after repair.
Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.

tasks.text: Position vehicles, machinery, equipment, physical structures, and other objects for assembly or installation, using hand tools, power tools, and moving equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual tool and equipment positioning in field

dwas.name: Position equipment using hand tools, power tools, or heavy equipment.

tasks.text: Transfer tools, parts, equipment, and supplies to and from work stations and other areas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual moving of materials and supplies

dwas.name: Move materials, equipment, or supplies.

tasks.text: Adjust, maintain, and repair tools, equipment, and machines, and assist more skilled workers with similar tasks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.
Maintain work equipment or machinery.

tasks.text: Order new parts to maintain inventory.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Apply protective materials to equipment, components, and parts to prevent defects and corrosion.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual application of protective coverings

dwas.name: Apply protective coverings to objects or surfaces near work areas.

tasks.text: Design, weld, and fabricate parts, using blueprints or other mechanical plans.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

dwas.name: Fabricate parts or components.
Operate welding equipment.

tasks.text: Assemble and maintain physical structures, using hand or power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Assembling structural components is hands-on

dwas.name: Assemble structural components.

tasks.text: Prepare work stations for use by mechanics and repairers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.
